name: session_export
description: render one saved session as a self-contained HTML transcript

return_html.description: Return the rendered document in the "html" field instead of writing it to disk. Nothing is stored, so a later forget has no file to remove. The response's "path" is where the file would have gone, not one that exists.

format.description: Render as a self-contained HTML page (default) or as Markdown. Chooses the file extension of state/exports/<id>.<ext> too.

forget.description: Host-internal: delete this session's export instead of writing one, called when its transcript is deleted
